Convert transactions from one AXI4 Manager into ordered APB4 transfers through one APB port.
The bridge uses one shared clock and has one global transaction active at a time. / Chuyển giao dịch từ một AXI4 Manager thành các transfer APB4 tuần tự qua một cổng.
Bridge dùng chung một clock và mỗi lúc chỉ có một giao dịch hoạt động.

Included: AXI4 read/write channels; FIXED, INCR and WRAP bursts; 32-bit addresses/data; 1-, 2-, and 4-byte transfers; IDs; PSTRB; PPROT; error propagation and defensive request rejection. / Bao gồm: kênh đọc/ghi AXI4; burst FIXED, INCR, WRAP; địa chỉ/dữ liệu 32 bit; transfer 1, 2, 4 byte; ID; PSTRB; PPROT; truyền lỗi và từ chối request phòng vệ.

Excluded: internal address decode, multiple APB ports, exclusive accesses, USER/QOS/REGION sidebands, CSR, CDC, timeout, speculation and pipelined transactions. / Không bao gồm: giải mã địa chỉ nội bộ, nhiều cổng APB, exclusive access, sideband USER/QOS/REGION, CSR, CDC, timeout, speculation và transaction pipeline.

Standard: AMBA AXI; Revision / profile: IHI 0022 Issue H.c, AXI4; Role implemented: Subordinate; Options: 32-bit address/data; configurable ID width; no AxLOCK, USER, QOS, REGION; Deviations: Unsupported AxCACHE returns SLVERR.

Standard: AMBA APB; Revision / profile: IHI 0024 Issue D, APB4 profile; Role implemented: Manager / Requester; Options: 32-bit address/data, PSTRB and PPROT; Deviations: External decoder; no APB5 sidebands.
Each mandatory requirement has a unique ID, source and verification method.
Section 19 provides the trace. / Mỗi yêu cầu bắt buộc có ID, nguồn và phương pháp kiểm chứng.
Mục 19 liên kết các yêu cầu.

ID: REQ-FUNC-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall convert each accepted AXI transaction into ordered APB transfers and return its AXI completion. / Chuyển giao dịch AXI thành APB tuần tự và trả completion.; Source: REF-001/002; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Independent model simulation

ID: REQ-FUNC-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall keep at most one global read or write transaction active. / Mỗi lúc chỉ một giao dịch đọc hoặc ghi hoạt động.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Assertions

ID: REQ-FUNC-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: When AR and AW are both pending, the bridge shall grant by round-robin, choose AR for the first tie after reset, and flip the next tie preference after each completed transaction. / Khi AR và AW cùng chờ, bridge phân xử round-robin, ưu tiên AR ở lần hòa đầu tiên sau reset và đổi ưu tiên sau mỗi giao dịch hoàn tất.; Source: Decision; WF-011; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Directed arbitration test

ID: REQ-IF-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall accept an AXI transfer only when VALID and READY are high at rising ACLK. / Chỉ nhận AXI khi VALID và READY cao tại cạnh lên ACLK.; Source: REF-001 A3.1–A3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: AXI checker

ID: REQ-IF-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall support FIXED (1–16 beats), INCR (1–256 beats), and WRAP (2/4/8/16 beats). / Hỗ trợ FIXED (1–16 beat), INCR (1–256 beat) và WRAP (2/4/8/16 beat).; Source: REF-001 A3.4; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Burst scoreboard

ID: REQ-IF-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall support AxSIZE 0/1/2 (1/2/4 bytes); reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB crossing without APB. / Hỗ trợ AxSIZE 0/1/2; từ chối size/burst không hỗ trợ và vượt 4 KiB, không truy cập APB.; Source: REF-001 A3.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative tests

ID: REQ-IF-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to four-byte word; copy WSTRB to PSTRB and drive PSTRB=0 on reads. / Căn PADDR xuống word 4 byte; chép WSTRB sang PSTRB, PSTRB=0 khi đọc.; Source: REF-002 §§2.1, 3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: APB monitor

ID: REQ-IF-005; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat and AWID on the corresponding B response. / Phản hồi ARID trên mọi beat R và AWID trên B tương ứng.; Source: REF-001 A5.1–A5.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: ID scoreboard

ID: REQ-IF-006; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall copy AxPROT to PPROT; omit AxLOCK, USER, QOS and REGION ports. / Chép AxPROT sang PPROT; bỏ các port AxLOCK, USER, QOS, REGION.; Source: REF-001 A4.7; REF-002 §3.5; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Interface inspection

ID: REQ-IF-007; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall accept only AxCACHE 0000/0001; otherwise return SLVERR without PSEL. / Chỉ nhận AxCACHE 0000/0001; trường hợp khác trả SLVERR, không bật PSEL.; Source: REF-001 A4.3–A4.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Attribute test

ID: REQ-IF-008; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall do not implement exclusive access; integration shall not send exclusive traffic. / Không triển khai exclusive; hệ thống không gửi exclusive traffic.; Source: REF-001 A7.2.3; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Interface review

ID: REQ-IF-009; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall hold AXI VALID/payload through handshake and APB control/payload stable while PREADY=0. / Giữ ổn định VALID/payload AXI đến handshake và APB khi PREADY=0.; Source: REF-001 A3.2; REF-002 §3.1; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Protocol assertions

ID: REQ-CLK-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall use one shared ACLK/PCLK domain; contain no asynchronous clock crossing. / Dùng chung ACLK/PCLK; không có CDC bất đồng bộ.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: CDC analysis

ID: REQ-RESET-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall use one active-low reset synchronous to ACLK; the SoC shall supply the reset synchronized to ACLK, and AXI VALID outputs shall be low while reset is sampled active. / Bridge dùng một reset active-low đồng bộ với ACLK; SoC phải cấp reset đã đồng bộ với ACLK và AXI VALID phải thấp khi reset được lấy mẫu ở mức active.; Source: REF-001 A3.1; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Reset test

ID: REQ-PARAM-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: PARA_AXI_ID_W shall range from 1 to 16, default 4, and set both read/write ID widths. / PARA_AXI_ID_W từ 1 đến 16, mặc định 4, đặt độ rộng ID đọc/ghi.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Elaboration sweep

ID: REQ-ERR-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported reads return ARLEN+1 SLVERR beats, RLAST only on final beat, no APB. / Read không hỗ trợ trả ARLEN+1 beat SLVERR, RLAST ở beat cuối, không APB.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative read test

ID: REQ-ERR-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall map read PSLVERR to that R beat SLVERR; accumulate write errors into final BRESP after all declared W beats. / Lỗi read trả SLVERR ở beat đó; lỗi write tích lũy vào BRESP cuối sau đủ beat W.; Source: REF-001 A3.4.5; REF-002 §3.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Error injection

ID: REQ-ERR-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported writes drain AWLEN+1 W beats without APB, then return one SLVERR B. / Write không hỗ trợ nhận đủ AWLEN+1 beat W, không APB, rồi trả B SLVERR.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative write test

ID: REQ-ERR-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall external APB fabric provides default unmapped Completer with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1. / Fabric APB cung cấp Completer mặc định cho địa chỉ unmapped, PREADY=1, PSLVERR=1.; Source: Decision; Applies to: Integration; Verification method: Integration test

ID: REQ-ERR-005; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall have no APB timeout; hold access while PREADY=0 and wait indefinitely if it never rises. / Không timeout APB; giữ access khi PREADY=0, chờ vô hạn nếu không lên.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Wait-state assertion

ID: REQ-ERR-006; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall completed APB transfer with PSLVERR=1 causes associated AXI response SLVERR. / APB hoàn tất với PSLVERR=1 làm AXI response báo SLVERR.; Source: REF-002 §3.4; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Error injection

ID: REQ-CSR-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall contain no software-visible CSR interface. / Không có CSR phần mềm.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Port inspection

ID: REQ-VER-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: Verification shall derive expected verification results from this specification and cited standards, never generated RTL. / Expected result lấy từ đặc tả và chuẩn, không từ RTL được sinh.; Source: Verification policy; Applies to: All; Verification method: Reference-model review

ID: REQ-VER-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: Verification deliverables shall retain generated testbench sources/commands and use one Makefile as the documented command entry point. / Lưu testbench/lệnh chạy; dùng một Makefile làm điểm vào được mô tả.; Source: Verification policy; Applies to: All; Verification method: Artifact audit

Configuration ID: CFG-BASE; Enabled features: Full AXI4 Subordinate, APB4 Manager, legal FIXED/INCR/WRAP, ID echo; Disabled features: CDC, timeout, CSR, exclusive, USER/QOS/REGION; Interfaces / widths: AXI 32/32; APB 32/32; ID default 4; shared clock; Intended use: Peripheral transactions; Verification target: Protocol/function/error/boundary/backpressure
Only CFG-BASE is defined.
AXI ID width is elaboration-configurable.
Decoder and default error Completer are external. / Chỉ định nghĩa CFG-BASE. Độ rộng ID cấu hình khi elaboration.
Decoder và Completer lỗi mặc định ở ngoài.
The RTL hierarchy has one structural top and three child modules.
The top contains only instances and port wiring.
The read and write sequencers translate AXI transactions into internal APB requests. m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl combines round-robin AR/AW arbitration, transaction ownership, and the shared APB4 controller.
AXI response backpressure stalls the owning sequencer. / Hierarchy RTL gồm một top cấu trúc và ba module con.
Top chỉ chứa instance và kết nối port.
Sequencer đọc/ghi chuyển AXI thành yêu cầu APB nội bộ. m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl gộp phân xử AR/AW round-robin, quản lý quyền sở hữu giao dịch và điều khiển APB4 dùng chung.
Backpressure response AXI giữ sequencer đang sở hữu giao dịch.

RTL module: m_axi2apb_rd_seq; Responsibility: Validate AR, generate burst addresses, request APB reads, and return R beats / Kiểm tra AR, sinh địa chỉ burst, yêu cầu APB read và trả beat R; Internal interface: AXI AR/R; rd_req / rd_rsp; Clock/reset domain: CLK-AXI / RST-AXI; State or storage: Address, beat count, ID

RTL module: m_axi2apb_wr_seq; Responsibility: Accept AW/W, request APB writes, aggregate errors, and return B / Nhận AW/W, yêu cầu APB write, tích lũy lỗi và trả B; Internal interface: AXI AW/W/B; wr_req / wr_rsp; Clock/reset domain: CLK-AXI / RST-AXI; State or storage: Address, beat count, ID, error status

RTL module: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl; Responsibility: Arbitrate AR/AW round-robin, retain the transaction owner through final R/B, select read/write requests, and drive APB setup/access / Phân xử AR/AW round-robin, giữ quyền sở hữu đến R/B cuối, chọn yêu cầu đọc/ghi và điều khiển APB setup/access; Internal interface: AXI ARVALID/AWVALID; sequencer ready/done; gnt_rd/gnt_wr; rd_req/rd_rsp; wr_req/wr_rsp; APB4; Clock/reset domain: CLK-AXI / RST-AXI; State or storage: Arbitration turn, active owner, APB phase and payload
The enclosing frame is the top module m_axi2apb_bridge; each solid module box inside it is one child RTL module.
Dashed side panels show the top-level AXI4/APB4 port bundles and are not RTL modules.
The APB decoder, default error Completer, and peripheral Completers are outside this RTL hierarchy. / Khung ngoài là top m_axi2apb_bridge; mỗi khối module nét liền bên trong là một RTL module con.
Hai bảng nét đứt hai bên mô tả nhóm port AXI4/APB4 và không phải RTL module.
Decoder APB, default error Completer và các Completer ngoại vi nằm ngoài hierarchy RTL này.
Editable vector source: figures/vlsit_block_diagram.svg. / File vector SVG có thể chỉnh sửa tại đường dẫn trên.

Read: accept AR, validate, perform one APB read per beat in AXI order, then present RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID and hold until RREADY. / Read: nhận AR, kiểm tra, thực hiện APB read mỗi beat theo thứ tự AXI, rồi đưa RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID, giữ đến RREADY.
Write: accept AW then W beats in order.
WVALID may precede AW but WREADY remains low until AW.
Perform one APB write per beat; after the last APB completion, return B. / Write: nhận AW rồi W theo thứ tự.
WVALID có thể đến trước AW nhưng WREADY thấp đến khi nhận AW.
Mỗi beat ghi APB; trả B sau APB cuối.
One transaction owns the bridge; reads and writes do not interleave.
APB transfers are sequential; payload/control remain stable during wait.
IDs are retained and echoed unchanged.
Read count is ARLEN+1; legal write count is AWLEN+1.
AXI response payload remains stable while VALID=1 and READY=0.

Interface ID: IF-001; Type and revision: AXI4, IHI 0022 H.c; Role: Subordinate; Direction at IP boundary: AXI Manager ↔ bridge; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Required / optional: Required; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Interface ID: IF-002; Type and revision: APB4, IHI 0024 D; Role: Manager/Requester; Direction at IP boundary: Bridge ↔ APB fabric; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; PCLK=ACLK; Required / optional: Required; Configurations: CFG-BASE
Inputs are sampled on rising i_clk_axi when the associated handshake/completion condition holds.
APB setup uses PSEL=1/PENABLE=0; access uses PSEL=1/PENABLE=1 and completes at PREADY=1. / Input được lấy mẫu tại cạnh lên i_clk_axi khi handshake/điều kiện hoàn tất tương ứng.
APB setup dùng PSEL=1/PENABLE=0; access dùng PSEL=1/PENABLE=1 và hoàn tất khi PREADY=1.

Port: i_clk_axi; Direction: Input; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Shared ACLK/PCLK / Clock AXI/APB chung; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: clock; Reset / idle value: Not applicable (clock is not resettable); Timing / sampling: Rising edge; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_rst_n_axi; Direction: Input; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Shared active-low synchronous reset / Reset active-low đồng bộ dùng chung; Clock domain: Synchronous to CLK-AXI; Signal type: reset; Reset / idle value: 0 asserts; Timing / sampling: Sampled on rising CLK-AXI edge; SoC supplies a clock-synchronous reset; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awid; Direction: Input; Width: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Meaning (function): Write ID / ID ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awaddr; Direction: Input; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Write byte address / Địa chỉ byte ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awlen; Direction: Input; Width: 8; Meaning (function): Write beats minus one / Số beat ghi trừ một; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awsize; Direction: Input; Width: 3; Meaning (function): Write byte-size encoding / Mã kích thước ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awburst; Direction: Input; Width: 2; Meaning (function): Write burst type / Loại burst ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awcache; Direction: Input; Width: 4; Meaning (function): Write memory attribute / Thuộc tính ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awprot; Direction: Input; Width: 3; Meaning (function): Write protection / Bảo vệ ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (AWVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if AWVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_awvalid; Direction: Input; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Write address valid / Địa chỉ ghi hợp lệ; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: level; Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Hold payload to AWREADY; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: o_axi_awready; Direction: Output; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Accept write address / Nhận địa chỉ ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: level; Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: AW handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_wdata; Direction: Input; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Write beat data / Dữ liệu beat ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (WVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if WVALID=0; Timing / sampling: W handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_wstrb; Direction: Input; Width: 4; Meaning (function): Write byte lanes / Lane byte ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (WVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if WVALID=0; Timing / sampling: W handshake; copied to PSTRB; Configurations: CFG-BASE

Port: i_axi_wlast; Direction: Input; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Final W beat marker / Đánh dấu W cuối; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (WVALID); Reset / idle value: Ignored if WVALID=0; Timing / sampling: AXI-compliant Manager asserts on beat AWLEN+1; malformed WLAST is outside the guaranteed profile; Configurations: CFG-BASE

The bridge shall convert each accepted AXI transaction into ordered APB transfers and return its AXI completion. / Chuyển giao dịch AXI thành APB tuần tự và trả completion.
The bridge shall keep at most one global read or write transaction active. / Mỗi lúc chỉ một giao dịch đọc hoặc ghi hoạt động.

When AR and AW are both pending, the bridge shall grant by round-robin, choose AR for the first tie after reset, and flip the next tie preference after each completed transaction. / Khi AR và AW cùng chờ, bridge phân xử round-robin, ưu tiên AR ở lần hòa đầu tiên sau reset và đổi ưu tiên sau mỗi giao dịch hoàn tất.
The bridge shall accept an AXI transfer only when VALID and READY are high at rising ACLK. / Chỉ nhận AXI khi VALID và READY cao tại cạnh lên ACLK.
The bridge shall support FIXED (1–16 beats), INCR (1–256 beats), and WRAP (2/4/8/16 beats). / Hỗ trợ FIXED (1–16 beat), INCR (1–256 beat) và WRAP (2/4/8/16 beat).

The bridge shall support AxSIZE 0/1/2 (1/2/4 bytes); reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB crossing without APB. / Hỗ trợ AxSIZE 0/1/2; từ chối size/burst không hỗ trợ và vượt 4 KiB, không truy cập APB.
The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to four-byte word; copy WSTRB to PSTRB and drive PSTRB=0 on reads. / Căn PADDR xuống word 4 byte; chép WSTRB sang PSTRB, PSTRB=0 khi đọc.
The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat and AWID on the corresponding B response. / Phản hồi ARID trên mọi beat R và AWID trên B tương ứng.
The bridge shall copy AxPROT to PPROT; omit AxLOCK, USER, QOS and REGION ports. / Chép AxPROT sang PPROT; bỏ các port AxLOCK, USER, QOS, REGION.
